 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ravi Chirania
Order 07/11/2025
1.

The petitioner -Girdhari Lal S/o Lalaram Rawat aged about 27 Years has been arrested on
09.06.2025 in connection with Fir No.121/2025 of Police Station - Panchu, District - Bikaner for
the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 376(3) and 506 of I.P.C., sections 3/4(2), 5(L)/6, 6
of Pocso Act and section 84 of Jj Act.

The petitioner's bail application was rejected by the learned
trial Court vide order dated 04.09.2025, thereafter, the petitioner has preferred this bail application
under Section 483 B.N.S.S.
2.

Learned counsel for the accused-petitioner submits that on 14.05.2025, at the behest of the
complainant, who declared her age as 19 years on the date of the registration of the Fir, it was
alleged that the present petitioner sexually harassed her and (Uploaded on 07/11/2025 at 03:05:46
Pm) [2025:Rj-Jd:47806] (2 of 3) [Crlmb-11564/2025] committed the offences as narrated in the
Fir.

Learned counsel further submits that the complainant has stated that the petitioner committed
rape upon her about 4 years ago, for which she has now lodged the Fir.

3. It is further submitted that the complainant herself admitted that she got married on 07.07.2022,
which indicated that her marriage was performed when she was a minor, and she is presently
residing
with her husband

. Learned counsel also submits that while the alleged incident is stated to

have occurred on 29.04.2025, the Fir came to be lodged on 14.05.2025, which reflects a serious
delay in reporting the alleged incident.

sentences.text:
4. It is further contended that there are serious contradictions between the version of the
complainant as recorded under section 183 B.N.S.S. and the statement of her husband recorded
under section 180 B.N.S.S. on 03.06.2025.

In view of the above, learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that the present case is frivolous and baseless and the petitioner has not committed any
such offence.
Therefore, he deserves to be enlarged on bail.
5. The service upon the complainant is complete, as informed by the learned Public Prosecutor.

6. Learned Public Prosecutor has strongly opposed the bail application on the ground that the
complainant has levelled serious allegations pertaining to an incident that occurred when she was a
minor, and her allegations are specific, as mentioned in her statement recorded under section 183
B.N.S.S.
Therefore, it is prayed that the petitioner may not be granted bail.
7. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

This Court considered the challan papers, the serious delay
in reporting the incident, the (Uploaded on 07/11/2025 at 03:05:46 Pm) [2025:Rj-Jd:47806] (3 of
3) [Crlmb-11564/2025] medical report dated 17.05.2025, and the material contradictions in the
statements of the complainant, her husband, and other witnesses who attempted to support her
version.
8.

Noticing these serious contradictions and the fact that the incident which allegedly occurred more
than 4 years ago, has been reported belatedly through the impugned Fir, this Court finds that the
same does not inspire confidence.

Be that as it may, in view of the above, considering the long
incarceration of the petitioner, this Court deems it just and proper to grant bail to the accused-
petitioner under Section 483 B.N.S.S.
9.

Accordingly, the bail application filed under Section 483 B.N.S.S. is allowed and it is directed that
accused-petitioner - Girdhari Lal S/o Lalaram shall be released on bail in connection with Fir No.
121/2025 of Police Station - Panchu, District - Bikaner, provided he executes a personal bond in a
sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of
learned trial Court for his appearance before that Court on each and every date of hearing and
whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.

The petitioner is further directed not
to take undue advantage of liberty or misuse liberty.

It is made clear that the observation as made by
this Court in the bail application will not affect the trial of the case.

(Ravi Chirania),J 101-KshamaD/-
